title: SGLang through 0.5.23, fixed in commit 7b5fb39, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST…
description: SGLang versions through 0.5.23 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /load_lora_adapter_from_tensors endpoint. This endpoint lacks the required admin-level authorization decorator, allowing unauthenticated attackers to invoke it without an API key. Exploiting this flaw, attackers can load a LoRA adapter from attacker-supplied serialized tensors to manipulate the served model. When combined with a separate deserialization bypass vulnerability, this can lead to unauthenticated remote code execution as root. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 7.5 and was fixed in commit 7b5fb39.
